source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of the chapter opening and the Interesting Information box (PDF 18-19).

blocks.text: Is chapter mein hum simple harmonic motion (S.H.M) parhenge. Yeh oscillatory motion (aage peeche jhoolne wali harkat) ki ek khaas qism hai jis mein restoring force (wapas lane wali force) cheez ko hamesha us ki mean position (darmiyani jagah) ki taraf wapas kheenchti hai. Hum S.H.M ke peeche ki mathematics aur physics bhi dekhenge: is ki khoobiyan (characteristics), is ki equations aur rozmarra zindagi mein is ke istemal.

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Qudrat mein bohat si cheezen periodic motion (baar baar ek jaisi dohrane wali harkat) karti hain, jaise Zameen ka Sooraj ke gird ghoomna, chaand ka Zameen ke gird ghoomna, pani ki lehrein, awaz ki lehrein, tuning fork aur jhoolne wali kursi (rocking chair).

blocks.prompt: Qudrat mein periodic motion ki teen misalein dein.
blocks.explanation: In mein se koi teen: Zameen ka Sooraj ke gird ghoomna, chaand ka Zameen ke gird ghoomna, pani ki lehrein, awaz ki lehrein, thartharata (vibrating) tuning fork, rocking chair.

items: S.H.M ek khaas oscillatory motion hai jis mein restoring force cheez ko hamesha mean position ki taraf wapas laati hai. Qudrat mein periodic motion aam hai.
